name: MyOS Session Subscription Requested
description: Request asking MyOS Admin to start a provider-mediated subscription to a logical source document. The request targets a document, not a specific session. MyOS Admin chooses an eligible session unless the matching mandate constrains one. The subscriber is inferred from the requesting document session.

filter.description: Optional filter for the root source document.

anchor.description: Link anchor whose linked documents should be observed.

filter.description: Optional filter for linked documents under this anchor. When absent, defaults include all events and no snapshots.
